scoring_justification: Checker recomputes doping densities from the agent's calibration CSV via interpolation and compares to paper-reported reference values; a full recompute of the derived headline quantity is feasible and is the strongest applicable tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: target doping densities and tolerance for Fermi shifts of 0.35 eV and 0.20 eV
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.5 and text: InAs substrate gives 0.35 eV shift with 5.5e13 e/cm²; graphene gives 0.20 eV with 3.2e13 e/cm².
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper sentences: 'calculated electron surface density is 5.5e13 electrons/cm²' and '0.20 eV ... 3.2e13 electrons/cm²'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual numbers reported in the paper, not invented.

outputs.description: Calibration table relating added electron surface density (electrons/cm²) to Fermi energy shift (eV). The checker will interpolate from this table to derive the densities corresponding to specific hidden Fermi shift values and compare them to hidden paper-reported values.

output_contract.notes: The agent must not include the derived doping densities in this file; the checker does its own interpolation.

steps.description: Interpolate doping_calibration.csv to find electron surface densities corresponding to Fermi shifts of 0.35 eV and 0.20 eV, then compare to hidden reference values with relative tolerance of 20%.
